chapter: Own band and New York period
title: Staying with Branford in New Rochelle
summary: In 1997 he moved north to stay with Branford but did little there.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Let me return to the bio, just to keep the chronology straight. You moved to New York, it says here, in September of ’97.

Well, I moved to – I stayed with Branford. I didn’t really move to New York. I moved up to stay with Branford. He was in New Rochelle. I was trying to change things up. So I moved up to New York, but I didn’t really do much. If – I wish I had moved to Manhattan. But by me being in New Rochelle and Branford, it’s just – you got to – one hour to get to the city. I didn’t do much there. I hung out with Branford more. That was cool.
